summary: The registered contrast compares HFD with chow in sham-operated mice using astrocyte IP RNA. The public author tables report orchiectomy effects and three-group trends. The proposal passed validation, and all 63 downloaded sources passed checksum verification.
openIssues: The paper names nine IP genes and then two supernatant genes before describing an unpublished sham diet test as nonsignificant. All nine IP genes fall above the registered FDR cutoff, but the wording leaves their author calls unresolved. The fraction-specific diet results and model are needed to assess agreement. [Published Results accompanying Figure 3](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10202485/#F0003)
